- **poisson**: Poisson equation / diffusion (variants: 2d, 3d, l_domain, rectangle)
- **linear_elasticity**: Linear elasticity (small strain) (variants: 2d, 3d, plate_hole, thick_beam)
- **heat**: Heat conduction (steady / transient) (variants: 2d_steady, 2d_transient, rectangle)
